name: Omalang
author: glafeara
description: Keyboard layout manager for the Omarchy bar: switch layouts, add and remove languages, with a centered on-screen indicator after every switch.

barWidget.description: Current layout on the bar. Left click opens the panel to switch, add or remove languages; right click cycles layouts. A centered OSD shows the layout abbreviation after each switch.

schema.label: Show centered indicator on layout switch
